decided_by: Người dùng xác nhận các đề xuất mặc định D1–D6 trong TASKS_HOAN_THIEN.md; D4 chọn sampled softmax CE vì máy không có GPU CUDA. v1.1.0 (2026-11-23): người dùng duyệt các bổ sung sau review: paired bootstrap, V-SKNN/STAN, biến thể loại item đã xem, giới hạn fallback top-N, cắt prefix cho KNN. v1.2.0 (2026-11-23): người dùng chọn bộ phương pháp theo tài liệu 'Tổng quan phương pháp gợi ý theo phiên trên RetailRocket' (GRU4Rec tự cài theo bản chính thức, SR-GNN nút = item cạnh giữa nhóm) và bỏ luật available khỏi bộ lọc ứng viên chính vì 17,6% target validation có available = 0 tại t. v1.3.0 (2026-11-24): người dùng thu hẹp phạm vi: chỉ bài toán tương tác kế tiếp; so sánh hai ngưỡng phiên 30 và 60 phút; trọng tâm là GRU4Rec gốc (chỉ item) so với GRU4Rec có embedding hành vi; mốc tham chiếu Popularity, Repeat-last, VSTAN, SR-GNN; người dùng duyệt đọc test thêm một lần cho bộ so sánh này (notebook 10). v1.3.1 (2026-11-26): người dùng tạm bỏ SR-GNN khỏi phạm vi và xóa notebook 08, src/rr/srgnn.py, test, mô hình và report của nó; mốc tham chiếu còn Popularity, Repeat-last, VSTAN. Lần chạy test v1.3.0 đang dở (có SR-GNN) bị dừng và xóa toàn bộ output; người dùng duyệt chạy lại test một lần với phạm vi v1.3.1, nên test đã được đọc một phần trước đó. v1.3.2 (2026-11-26): người dùng bỏ S-POP, SR và V-SKNN (notebook 05, 06 và code dùng chung) và chỉ giữ chỉ số tại K = 20; lần chạy test v1.3.1 được chặn trước khi đọc test, chạy lại 04 → 06, 09, 10 rồi mới đọc test một lần.

locked_protocol.note: Giao thức đã chốt ở notebook 01/02; không đổi khi chưa có xác nhận của người dùng.
locked_protocol.new_session_condition: visitor changes OR consecutive event gap > threshold
locked_protocol.split_unit: whole session; sessions crossing a cutoff -> boundary_drop
locked_protocol.boundary_drop_usage: never used as history, candidate source or label

samples.query: prefix = groups 1..t of a session (t >= 1); one query per t < n_groups
samples.query_time_ms: timestamp of group t (last prefix group)
samples.target: set of distinct itemid in group t+1, all behaviors; original IDs kept even when out of vocabulary
samples.prefix_storage: not materialised; read events_sessionized by session_id and group_index <= prefix_len_groups

vocabulary.source: every itemid in train events, including single-group sessions
vocabulary.trainval_variant: same rule on train + validation events, used only for the D2 refit before test

metadata.as_of_rule: latest update with timestamp <= t (merge_asof direction=backward, by itemid)
metadata.missing: unknown; never filled from the future

rules: itemid in the vocabulary of the fitting data

known_at.train: known_at_train_ms = min(first train event, first property record of any property)
known_at.train_validation: known_at_trainval_ms = min(first train/validation event, first property record)

candidates.applies_to: every model and the Popularity fallback
candidates.fallback: Popularity ranking of the fitting data, uniform behavior weights unless the tuned weights are better on validation
candidates.missing_slots: if fewer than K eligible items remain, empty slots count as misses
candidates.fallback_note: only the top fallback_top_n Popularity items are scanned per query (memory bound); a run asserts that every query still gets K eligible items

availability_variant.rule: latest available with timestamp <= t != 0 (unknown is kept)
availability_variant.use: secondary report only, for the best configuration of each model family
availability_variant.reason: 17.62% of validation targets (15.43% of train targets) were interacted with while their latest available value was 0; the property is a weekly snapshot and does not block interaction

repeat_targets.flag: target_is_repeat per (query, item): item appears anywhere in the prefix
repeat_targets.baseline: Repeat-last: prefix items by most recent group, ties by stronger behavior then itemid; filled by Popularity fallback
repeat_targets.optional_ablation: merge consecutive groups with the same (item, behavior) set — not run unless time allows

long_sessions.gru_train_truncation: sessions longer than 51 groups are cut into windows of at most 51 groups (overlap 1 group); hidden state resets at each window; evaluation uses the full prefix

refit.refit_rule: same configuration; GRU uses the epoch count selected on validation; vocabulary, popularity, similarities, session store and known_at recomputed on train+validation
refit.test_runs: each variant evaluated on test exactly once after freezing

gru4rec.input_per_step: gru4rec: mean item embedding of the timestamp group + mean behavior embedding (view/addtocart/transaction); gru4rec_item: mean item embedding only (same architecture and hyperparameters, behavior embedding removed)
gru4rec.loss: selected on validation among cross-entropy (sampled softmax, log-Q corrected) and bpr-max; see methods.gru4rec
gru4rec.multi_item_targets: uniform label split: each correct item gets weight 1/|G|
gru4rec.oov_input_items: mapped to PAD (ignored in the group mean); behavior embedding still used
ablations: shuffle group order inside the prefix

evaluation.ks_note: K = 10 dropped in v1.3.2 (user, 2026-11-26): every report uses K = 20 only
evaluation.gain: binary; log2 discount; IDCG over min(|G|, K) positions
evaluation.denominator: every query with non-empty target, including out-of-vocabulary targets (score 0)

paired_bootstrap.use: differences listed in scope.comparisons, same resampled queries for both models

tasks.next_interaction: next interaction only: target = distinct items of group t+1, every behavior, all queries

code_layout.shared_code: src/rr (io, metrics, candidates, samples, models, gru, evaluation, ablation, demo)

exclude_seen.variant: every model except Repeat-last is also evaluated with prefix items removed from its candidates
exclude_seen.primary: models are selected on the default variant (prefix items allowed); exclude_seen is reported in the validation notebooks 05-07 only, not in the final test of scope v1.3.x

knn.note: only the most recent 50 prefix groups are used by KNN scorers (older groups have negligible decay weight); GRU evaluation still uses the full prefix
knn.fit_data: train sessions only (train+validation for the D2 refit)

methods.source: docs: Tổng quan phương pháp gợi ý theo phiên trên RetailRocket (2026-11-23)

knn.stan: STAN (lambda1 prefix position, lambda2 neighbour recency, lambda3 neighbour position)
knn.vstan: STAN + IDF weighting of shared items and of candidate items (lambda_idf)
knn.itemknn: kept from T11 as an extra non-sequential neighbour baseline

methods.gru4rec: own implementation following the official GRU4Rec feature set (Hidasi & Czapp 2023): losses cross-entropy and bpr-max (elu, bpreg), shared negative sampling n_sample=2048 with sample_alpha, optional constrained embedding; grid starts from the official RetailRocket setting (hidden 224, batch 80); input = timestamp group, with (gru4rec) or without (gru4rec_item) behavior embedding; optimiser and regularisation differ from the official RetailRocket paramfile (here Adam/SparseAdam lr 0.002, sample_alpha 0.5, bpreg 1.0; official: Adagrad lr 0.05 with momentum 0.4, sample_alpha 0.4, bpreg 1.95, 10 epochs); notebook 13 runs the official code on validation as a check

notebooks.06: kNN family (SKNN, STAN, VSTAN) and ItemKNN
notebooks.09: GRU4Rec item-only vs behavior and 30/60-minute sessions: data and selection on validation
notebooks.10: final test run (next interaction, 30 and 60 minutes)

scope.task: next interaction only: target = distinct items of group t+1, every behavior, all queries
scope.session_threshold_note: notebooks 01-07 build the 30-minute data (locked_protocol); notebook 09 rebuilds sessions, groups, split (same cutoffs) and samples for 60 minutes with the same rules; both thresholds are reported

focus_models.gru4rec_item: original GRU4Rec input: mean item embedding of the timestamp group only
focus_models.gru4rec: multi-behavior GRU4Rec: mean item embedding + mean behavior embedding (view/addtocart/transaction) of the group

comparisons: gru4rec vs gru4rec_item on the same queries (paired bootstrap), each threshold
60-minute vs 30-minute models on the same queries (q30 and q60), each model
